verdict.rationale: Crossmint's own docs point toward portability: wallets are pitched as letting you 'switch providers without migrations' (crossmint-docs-9), and wallet webhooks mention 'signer exports' (crossmint-docs-17). That suggests keys and wallets can leave the platform, but there is no documented general data-export feature. missing for 10: a documented export of all account/user/order/transaction data, open export formats, a documented offboarding/exit procedure, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
